units.english: This planet is the collective seat of what are known as the Old Houses, the noble families who held territorial claims to this region of space before the collapse of the Predecessors' empire and the arrival of the so-called New Houses fleeing their crumbling society.
units.raw: description `This planet is the collective seat of what are known as the Old Houses, the noble families who held territorial claims to this region of space before the collapse of the Predecessors' empire and the arrival of the so-called New Houses fleeing their crumbling society.`

units.english: While today the planet is geologically stable, it has experienced major tectonic shifts in the past, folding the planet's surface into a number of visually spectacular canyons and mountain ranges. Since it serves such an important political role, tectonic activity on this planet is closely monitored, and even though there have been no major earthquakes since the Successors settled here, most of the buildings here are built to withstand even large and destructive geological shifts.
units.raw: description `	While today the planet is geologically stable, it has experienced major tectonic shifts in the past, folding the planet's surface into a number of visually spectacular canyons and mountain ranges. Since it serves such an important political role, tectonic activity on this planet is closely monitored, and even though there have been no major earthquakes since the Successors settled here, most of the buildings here are built to withstand even large and destructive geological shifts.`

units.english: Unexpectedly small for a planet of this importance, the spaceport on Aava-Aasa-Khora is composed of a number of small buildings made out of surprisingly flexible materials. While the sensation of the landing pad bowing under your ship's weight is unsettling, to say the least, it shows no signs of damage or structural fatigue.
units.raw: spaceport `Unexpectedly small for a planet of this importance, the spaceport on Aava-Aasa-Khora is composed of a number of small buildings made out of surprisingly flexible materials. While the sensation of the landing pad bowing under your ship's weight is unsettling, to say the least, it shows no signs of damage or structural fatigue.`

units.english: The inside of the spaceport is very similar, with soft, rounded shapes, and flexible building materials. The floor seems to sink a little as you step on it, almost like it is actually a viscous liquid rather than a solid material.
units.raw: spaceport `	The inside of the spaceport is very similar, with soft, rounded shapes, and flexible building materials. The floor seems to sink a little as you step on it, almost like it is actually a viscous liquid rather than a solid material.`

units.english: This ancient and quiet world, orbiting a dim red sun, is home to the microchip foundries of House Idriss, the Arach guild that specializes in computers and advanced electronics. Outside of the cities, which are clustered around the equator, Ablub's Invention is uninhabited except by the native lifeforms, including strange, spindly-legged quadrupeds, awkward birds with leathery wings, and amphibians with webbed feet and long, whiskered snouts.
units.raw: description `This ancient and quiet world, orbiting a dim red sun, is home to the microchip foundries of House Idriss, the Arach guild that specializes in computers and advanced electronics. Outside of the cities, which are clustered around the equator, Ablub's Invention is uninhabited except by the native lifeforms, including strange, spindly-legged quadrupeds, awkward birds with leathery wings, and amphibians with webbed feet and long, whiskered snouts.`

units.english: The day-night cycle here is at least three times as long as any of the Coalition's species are habituated to, so the entire city enters a "false nighttime" in the middle of the day, shuttering all the windows so that the locals can rest and reset their biological clocks. And in the middle of the night, the city is brightly lit for a "false day."
units.raw: spaceport `The day-night cycle here is at least three times as long as any of the Coalition's species are habituated to, so the entire city enters a "false nighttime" in the middle of the day, shuttering all the windows so that the locals can rest and reset their biological clocks. And in the middle of the night, the city is brightly lit for a "false day."`

units.english: The local work schedule has adapted to this unusual cycle, with the two true daytime periods serving the equivalent of the human work week, and the false daytime treated as a weekend, a time for socializing or working at home.
units.raw: spaceport `	The local work schedule has adapted to this unusual cycle, with the two true daytime periods serving the equivalent of the human work week, and the false daytime treated as a weekend, a time for socializing or working at home.`

units.english: Ada is the home planet of Lovelace Labs, one of the most highly respected designers of starship systems and weaponry. Ada was originally settled as a mining planet, and the mines here still produce a steady stream of metal to supply the Labs and the many other industrial companies here.
units.raw: description `Ada is the home planet of Lovelace Labs, one of the most highly respected designers of starship systems and weaponry. Ada was originally settled as a mining planet, and the mines here still produce a steady stream of metal to supply the Labs and the many other industrial companies here.`

units.english: From above, the planet looks almost lifeless and barren. Most of the major cities on Ada are built into the walls of the canyons, where they are protected from the high winds and occasional dust storms that sweep across the surface.
units.raw: description `	From above, the planet looks almost lifeless and barren. Most of the major cities on Ada are built into the walls of the canyons, where they are protected from the high winds and occasional dust storms that sweep across the surface.`

units.english: The spaceport is built into the walls of a canyon which has been blasted out to create trenches that are hundreds of meters wide and deep, a network of flight lanes that are well marked out with lights and beacons.
units.raw: spaceport `The spaceport is built into the walls of a canyon which has been blasted out to create trenches that are hundreds of meters wide and deep, a network of flight lanes that are well marked out with lights and beacons.`

units.english: Behind the docking caves is a bustling subterranean city where bare rock and gleaming metal have been woven together in an architecture that is both functional and elegant. The lighting in the caverns varies over the course of the day to match the sunlight outside.
units.raw: spaceport `	Behind the docking caves is a bustling subterranean city where bare rock and gleaming metal have been woven together in an architecture that is both functional and elegant. The lighting in the caverns varies over the course of the day to match the sunlight outside.`

units.english: Aera is a large tidally locked ice giant close to its parent star. Its methane atmosphere is dominated by a titanic hurricane covering the dayside half of the planet, the result of tidal forces drawing streams of air and clouds into a planet-sized storm. The eye of the hurricane is surprisingly calm, but the heat of perpetual daylight drives temperatures higher than what is habitable for most life.
units.raw: description `Aera is a large tidally locked ice giant close to its parent star. Its methane atmosphere is dominated by a titanic hurricane covering the dayside half of the planet, the result of tidal forces drawing streams of air and clouds into a planet-sized storm. The eye of the hurricane is surprisingly calm, but the heat of perpetual daylight drives temperatures higher than what is habitable for most life.`

units.english: The close proximity of Aetuah and the neighboring ice moon causes various ebbs and flows in the storms on the gas giant as well as constant reshaping of the moon's surface. The ice moon may have been captured by Aetuah in times past as a rogue planet, and the distance of the gas giant from the system center suggests it might be a rogue planet itself as well. In time, the gravitational force exhibited by Aetuah will tear apart the ice moon, plummeting it into the abyss.
units.raw: description `The close proximity of Aetuah and the neighboring ice moon causes various ebbs and flows in the storms on the gas giant as well as constant reshaping of the moon's surface. The ice moon may have been captured by Aetuah in times past as a rogue planet, and the distance of the gas giant from the system center suggests it might be a rogue planet itself as well. In time, the gravitational force exhibited by Aetuah will tear apart the ice moon, plummeting it into the abyss.`

units.english: The most striking features of Aetuah are large oval-shaped organisms inhabiting the upper atmosphere. These lifeforms resemble some of the space fauna of nearby systems, and have a strange behavior of slingshotting themselves away from Aetuah once they reach a certain size through some unknown propulsion method.
units.raw: description `	The most striking features of Aetuah are large oval-shaped organisms inhabiting the upper atmosphere. These lifeforms resemble some of the space fauna of nearby systems, and have a strange behavior of slingshotting themselves away from Aetuah once they reach a certain size through some unknown propulsion method.`

units.english: The homeworld of the Arach people, Ahr is a metropolitan world with nearly nine billion inhabitants, enough that they cannot all be fed by what this world produces. The government maintains a storehouse with a month's supply of food in each major metropolitan center, as well as a collection of bioreactors, built according to Kimek designs, that can produce a tasteless but nutritious paste as emergency rations in the unlikely event that shipments of food from off-world are somehow disrupted for a prolonged period of time.

The government maintains a storehouse with a month's supply of food in each major metropolitan center, as well as a collection of bioreactors, built according to Kimek designs, that can produce a tasteless but nutritious paste as emergency rations in the unlikely event that shipments of food from off-world are somehow disrupted for a prolonged period of time.`

units.english: A constant line of cargo barges and trucks streams through this spaceport city, collecting goods to be distributed to the outlying suburbs and neighboring cities. Inside the main terminal, members of all three Coalition species mix freely, but the Heliarch agents and interpreters here are all Arach.
units.raw: spaceport `A constant line of cargo barges and trucks streams through this spaceport city, collecting goods to be distributed to the outlying suburbs and neighboring cities. Inside the main terminal, members of all three Coalition species mix freely, but the Heliarch agents and interpreters here are all Arach.`

units.english: Carts carrying passengers and cargo whiz past at frightening speeds, expertly navigating to dodge the pedestrians.
units.raw: spaceport `	Carts carrying passengers and cargo whiz past at frightening speeds, expertly navigating to dodge the pedestrians.`

units.english: At first glance, Aksaray appears to be a fairly generic moon formed from eons of dust and debris compressed into a tight ball by constant gravitational pressure. What is not commonplace is the presence of almost perfectly pyramidal piles of regolith scattered across the world. Querying an orbiting Remnant satellite suggests that these are believed to have been remote mining sites for mineral processing.
units.raw: description `At first glance, Aksaray appears to be a fairly generic moon formed from eons of dust and debris compressed into a tight ball by constant gravitational pressure. What is not commonplace is the presence of almost perfectly pyramidal piles of regolith scattered across the world. Querying an orbiting Remnant satellite suggests that these are believed to have been remote mining sites for mineral processing.`

units.english: A brief consultation of your navigational computer's economic database, however, indicates that all the minerals present in this variant of regolith are very common across the galaxy and have an extremely low value.
units.raw: description `	A brief consultation of your navigational computer's economic database, however, indicates that all the minerals present in this variant of regolith are very common across the galaxy and have an extremely low value.`

units.english: The Aktina Cylinder is an incomplete space station of an enormous scale. Two dozen kilometers in diameter and three times that in length, when complete it will be able to house tens of millions of Avgi in urban conditions. Thousands of cylinders like these were built over the years in the Avgi core systems, but limited resources have constrained the Avgi in the Tangled Shroud to only building one over the last decade.
units.raw: description `The Aktina Cylinder is an incomplete space station of an enormous scale. Two dozen kilometers in diameter and three times that in length, when complete it will be able to house tens of millions of Avgi in urban conditions. Thousands of cylinders like these were built over the years in the Avgi core systems, but limited resources have constrained the Avgi in the Tangled Shroud to only building one over the last decade.`

units.english: With resources frequently reallocated towards new warships and mining installations, many wonder if the cylinder will ever be completed, which would provide enough space to allow the millions of Avgi in cryogenic storage to be revived. The main habitat body is still open to space, and the only area sealed against vacuum is a relatively small section tucked under what will be the habitat's "floor."

The main habitat body is still open to space, and the only area sealed against vacuum is a relatively small section tucked under what will be the habitat's "floor."`

units.english: Eons later, Alathil still resonates with the shocks of the supernova that reshaped the Tap system. The entire atmosphere is still in turmoil, with layers of gas upturned upon themselves. These exposed layers are the source of Alathil's vibrant coloring, which is both beautiful and deadly.
units.raw: description `Eons later, Alathil still resonates with the shocks of the supernova that reshaped the Tap system. The entire atmosphere is still in turmoil, with layers of gas upturned upon themselves. These exposed layers are the source of Alathil's vibrant coloring, which is both beautiful and deadly.`

units.english: The planet's magnetosphere is grossly deformed, distorted by Tap's own powerful field and twisted by the shocks still resonating in Alathil's metallic hydrogen core. This bends streams of deadly charged particles emitted from Tap directly into the atmosphere, scouring seemingly random bands across the planet's surface.
units.raw: description `	The planet's magnetosphere is grossly deformed, distorted by Tap's own powerful field and twisted by the shocks still resonating in Alathil's metallic hydrogen core. This bends streams of deadly charged particles emitted from Tap directly into the atmosphere, scouring seemingly random bands across the planet's surface.`

units.english: Albatross is a cold ocean world orbiting a small, cold sun. The first settlers on Albatross were anarchists who believed that in a society free from unnatural laws and constraints, everyone would happily and freely work for the common good. The next settlers were pirates who believed that a planet free from laws and constraints would be a great base of operations.
units.raw: description `Albatross is a cold ocean world orbiting a small, cold sun. The first settlers on Albatross were anarchists who believed that in a society free from unnatural laws and constraints, everyone would happily and freely work for the common good. The next settlers were pirates who believed that a planet free from laws and constraints would be a great base of operations.`

units.english: The anarchist farming communes, each operating independently but trading with outsiders to gain necessary supplies, are clustered in the barely temperate climate near the equator. The pirate bases, having a much more ready source of supplies, are located wherever there are flat landing areas close to craggy, defensible mountains.
units.raw: description `	The anarchist farming communes, each operating independently but trading with outsiders to gain necessary supplies, are clustered in the barely temperate climate near the equator. The pirate bases, having a much more ready source of supplies, are located wherever there are flat landing areas close to craggy, defensible mountains.`

units.english: You are glad you put on a warm coat before leaving your ship. The wind blows in strong gusts down the streets of this small spaceport town. You pass by ranchers herding cattle, a few farmers driving old, rusted-out trucks full of produce, and a couple of shady figures huddled in an alleyway negotiating what looks like a drug deal. In the center of town is a small merchant's exchange and a couple of greasy spoon diners.
units.raw: spaceport `You are glad you put on a warm coat before leaving your ship. The wind blows in strong gusts down the streets of this small spaceport town. You pass by ranchers herding cattle, a few farmers driving old, rusted-out trucks full of produce, and a couple of shady figures huddled in an alleyway negotiating what looks like a drug deal. In the center of town is a small merchant's exchange and a couple of greasy spoon diners.`

units.english: The sign over the spaceport bar reads, "No Gods, No Masters." Below it in slightly smaller writing is another sign which reads, "No Cybernetic Implants. No Badgers, Weasels, Or Polecats." You have no idea what a "polecat" is.
units.raw: spaceport `	The sign over the spaceport bar reads, "No Gods, No Masters." Below it in slightly smaller writing is another sign which reads, "No Cybernetic Implants. No Badgers, Weasels, Or Polecats." You have no idea what a "polecat" is.`

units.english: At the height of the Alpha Wars, the government of the Deep constructed Alexandria as the galaxy's largest storehouse of human literature, scientific writing, and technology. It also houses a vast museum of cultural artifacts dating back to long before the start of the space age. Today the station is mostly populated by visitors looking for particularly arcane writings or information, and librarians who have devoted their lives to keeping the archives well-indexed and up to date.
units.raw: description `At the height of the Alpha Wars, the government of the Deep constructed Alexandria as the galaxy's largest storehouse of human literature, scientific writing, and technology. It also houses a vast museum of cultural artifacts dating back to long before the start of the space age. Today the station is mostly populated by visitors looking for particularly arcane writings or information, and librarians who have devoted their lives to keeping the archives well-indexed and up to date.`

units.english: Entire sections of the station are off limits to ordinary visitors. There are many rumors about what those restricted areas contain.
units.raw: description `	Entire sections of the station are off limits to ordinary visitors. There are many rumors about what those restricted areas contain.`

units.english: The station's cavernous visitor center is by far the quietest spaceport you have ever been in. Many people are bustling back and forth, wheeling carts of old books or carrying data pads, but they are entirely silent except for the occasional startled outburst when a scholar, walking deep in thought or immersed in reading, accidentally collides with someone.
units.raw: spaceport `The station's cavernous visitor center is by far the quietest spaceport you have ever been in. Many people are bustling back and forth, wheeling carts of old books or carrying data pads, but they are entirely silent except for the occasional startled outburst when a scholar, walking deep in thought or immersed in reading, accidentally collides with someone.`

units.english: From here, passageways lead off into the wings of the library in a veritable labyrinth of hallways, stairs, and library stacks. A few particularly heavy doors require key cards to enter, and others have no opening controls of any sort that you can see.
units.raw: spaceport `	From here, passageways lead off into the wings of the library in a veritable labyrinth of hallways, stairs, and library stacks. A few particularly heavy doors require key cards to enter, and others have no opening controls of any sort that you can see.`

units.english: Various pieces of media pertaining to the Alpha Wars are front and center on the display racks in the library.
units.raw: spaceport `	Various pieces of media pertaining to the Alpha Wars are front and center on the display racks in the library.`

units.english: Alfheim is a world of wide grassy plains, deserts, a few small oceans, and scattered rainforests. Not a pleasant enough planet to support large cities, it is instead mostly a site for oil drilling and manufacturing. So far only a tiny fraction of the surface has been developed, mostly clustered around the sites where the largest oil deposits have been discovered.
units.raw: description `Alfheim is a world of wide grassy plains, deserts, a few small oceans, and scattered rainforests. Not a pleasant enough planet to support large cities, it is instead mostly a site for oil drilling and manufacturing. So far only a tiny fraction of the surface has been developed, mostly clustered around the sites where the largest oil deposits have been discovered.`

units.english: Settlements show up as small bright points on the dark side of the planet - not from city lights, but from natural gas burnoff at the drilling stations.
units.raw: description `	Settlements show up as small bright points on the dark side of the planet - not from city lights, but from natural gas burnoff at the drilling stations.`

units.english: The spaceport is in the middle of a field of oil derricks so vast that from above, the desert seemed to be covered in spiky gray fur. The spaceport itself is a soaring canopy, made to look like a tent, or sails on a ship. But it is built of a sturdy composite of plastic and carbon fiber, and coated in reflective plastic. Inside, hovercraft and massive sand-crawlers are bringing cargo to and from the refineries and factories scattered across the planet's surface.

units.english: Alix is a small moon of the gas giant Pathera, lacking a breathable atmosphere but rich in minerals. While settlements on the moon have been destroyed to the extent that all that remains are debris scattered across the terrain, some automated facilities are still functioning and see a constant flow of cargo drones that stop by the moon to gather raw materials before quickly bringing them to the nearby station's reserves.

units.english: This Earth-like planet has been settled both by human beings and by the Hai, the species that controls this region of space. The human settlements are relatively small, mostly farming communities founded by people who came here to escape the chaos and uncertainty of human space. More substantial urban settlements exist, particularly near the spaceport, but from the air they appear to exist within strict boundaries.

The human settlements are relatively small, mostly farming communities founded by people who came here to escape the chaos and uncertainty of human space. More substantial urban settlements exist, particularly near the spaceport, but from the air they appear to exist within strict boundaries.`

units.english: In the spaceport, a handful of human merchants and colonists wander about amid throngs of Hai - vaguely squirrel-like aliens who are somewhat shorter than the average human being, but make up for it with an abundance of energy. You feel a little bit like an adult wading through a sea of hyperactive children as you try to locate the commodity exchange and the other services offered here.

units.english: Despite the distance from Republic space, some humans have set up decorations in celebration of Remembrance Day. A handful of the more curious Hai mingle with the humans, asking them what the fuss is all about.
units.raw: spaceport `	Despite the distance from Republic space, some humans have set up decorations in celebration of Remembrance Day. A handful of the more curious Hai mingle with the humans, asking them what the fuss is all about.`

units.english: Decades ago, this large observatory station was constructed in order to peer into the anomalous region known as the Ember Waste. Before the Avgi were able to harden their ships against the prevalent ion storms, this was their only way to extract its secrets. An array of advanced telescopes covering the entire electromagnetic spectrum sits side by side with more exotic equipment, from gravitational wave interferometers to neutrino detectors.
units.raw: description `Decades ago, this large observatory station was constructed in order to peer into the anomalous region known as the Ember Waste. Before the Avgi were able to harden their ships against the prevalent ion storms, this was their only way to extract its secrets. An array of advanced telescopes covering the entire electromagnetic spectrum sits side by side with more exotic equipment, from gravitational wave interferometers to neutrino detectors.`

units.english: After Avgi starships advanced to the point of being able to reliably withstand ion storms, it was trained deeper into the Ember Waste, looking further back in both space and time. It gathered an impressive amount of data before the Incursion forced its abandonment, though fortunately the telescope seems to have been left unscathed.

units.english: This is a complete Quarg ringworld, the product of millennia of construction effort which has consumed every other stellar object in this system in order to provide the raw materials. The inner edge of the ring is filled with solar panels, hydroponic gardens, living quarters, and sunlit common spaces. The outer edge contains hangars and docks for ships, and storage facilities for cargo.
units.raw: description `This is a complete Quarg ringworld, the product of millennia of construction effort which has consumed every other stellar object in this system in order to provide the raw materials. The inner edge of the ring is filled with solar panels, hydroponic gardens, living quarters, and sunlit common spaces. The outer edge contains hangars and docks for ships, and storage facilities for cargo.`

units.english: Massive station-keeping thrusters on the ring's exterior keep its orbit from becoming unstable.
units.raw: description `	Massive station-keeping thrusters on the ring's exterior keep its orbit from becoming unstable.`

units.english: If this section of the ring is any indication, there must be trillions of Quarg here. Since the construction work on the ring has long since ended, many of them seem to spend their time with creative or scientific endeavors instead. The spaceport is decorated with artwork of every imaginable kind: sculptures, mobiles, paintings, music, and even one hallway that cycles through various artificial odors, some of them intensely unpleasant to your human senses.

units.english: Formerly "Fortaleza da Alvorada," Alvorada was hollowed out centuries ago to make an extensive network of bunker complexes that used to house the Politburo of the CCOR and the extensive computer system they built that administered their centrally-planned economy. Rumor has it that, in the deepest reaches of the complex where no pirates have yet been able to breach, they're still there, having adapted the system to instead direct the guerrillas in the reestablishment of their homeland.

Rumor has it that, in the deepest reaches of the complex where no pirates have yet been able to breach, they're still there, having adapted the system to instead direct the guerrillas in the reestablishment of their homeland.`

units.english: Alvorada's spaceport was built into one of the larger craters. Everything about the installation here is as fortified as possible - various hangars for even heavy warships are dug into the walls. From the ground, you can see where artillery pieces were stationed, obscured from above but with clear firing lines at incoming vessels. Now that you've seen them, you can think of hundreds of places across the asteroid where similar emplacements could have been hidden.

units.english: As far as desert worlds come, Amathil is merely dry and sandy, with a mild surface temperature that is surprisingly uniform across latitudes thanks to high altitude winds. While unattractive for settlement due to the scarcity of greenery, Amathil is still home to the descendents of those who arrived on the first few sublight starships, back when little was known about the planet besides that it had an oxygenated atmosphere. The unique culture that has since grown here, under a unified planetary government, emphasizes a sense of community and generosity - or at least that is how the locals like to be perceived by outsiders.

The unique culture that has since grown here, under a unified planetary government, emphasizes a sense of community and generosity - or at least that is how the locals like to be perceived by outsiders.`

units.english: Thanks to its abundant solar energy, the cost of powering the laser launch array that served Amathil was quite low, and glittering fields of solar panels surround the entire site. The spaceport itself is spartan, with Amathil not receiving much traffic on a daily basis even before the Incursion. Amathil's primary export was people, with many choosing to leave the isolated planet in favor of moving to one of the more cosmopolitan worlds elsewhere.

units.english: Amazon is a lush, green, tropical world, a popular tourist destination for many who live in this region of space. The indigenous forests are dense and hardy enough that growing human crops here is a constant battle, and none of the native plants or fruits are edible. Aside from tourism, most of the planet's income is from petroleum mining.
units.raw: description `Amazon is a lush, green, tropical world, a popular tourist destination for many who live in this region of space. The indigenous forests are dense and hardy enough that growing human crops here is a constant battle, and none of the native plants or fruits are edible. Aside from tourism, most of the planet's income is from petroleum mining.`

units.english: The forests are home to a stunning variety of wildlife, some of it dangerous but most of it entirely indifferent to human presence. Plant life is so abundant here that even the oceans are green rather than blue, teeming with kelp and algae.
units.raw: description `	The forests are home to a stunning variety of wildlife, some of it dangerous but most of it entirely indifferent to human presence. Plant life is so abundant here that even the oceans are green rather than blue, teeming with kelp and algae.`

units.english: The Amazon spaceport is unique, built on top of tall pillars more than fifty meters above the ground, directly above the forest canopy. The landing pads, buildings, and catwalks between them are laid out in a random branching pattern, forming a shape that from above looks almost organic. Directly over the railings, you can see brightly colored birds circling beneath your feet.
units.raw: spaceport `The Amazon spaceport is unique, built on top of tall pillars more than fifty meters above the ground, directly above the forest canopy. The landing pads, buildings, and catwalks between them are laid out in a random branching pattern, forming a shape that from above looks almost organic. Directly over the railings, you can see brightly colored birds circling beneath your feet.`

units.english: Anatrefo was discovered mere years after the Avgi discovered the hyperdrive, and was soon considered the most momentous discovery in Avgi history. An intact alien station, albeit one stripped of any advanced technologies, proved once and for all that the Avgi were not alone in the universe. Even more significant was a long, slender megastructure near the station, appearing as though construction on it had barely been started.
units.raw: description `Anatrefo was discovered mere years after the Avgi discovered the hyperdrive, and was soon considered the most momentous discovery in Avgi history. An intact alien station, albeit one stripped of any advanced technologies, proved once and for all that the Avgi were not alone in the universe. Even more significant was a long, slender megastructure near the station, appearing as though construction on it had barely been started.`

units.english: While study of the station's structure was hoped to provide insights into advanced alien technologies, it has so far proven stubbornly difficult to understand or reverse engineer, with some Avgi scientists remarking that even the station's materials appear to intelligently circumvent attempts to probe their internal structure.
units.raw: description `	While study of the station's structure was hoped to provide insights into advanced alien technologies, it has so far proven stubbornly difficult to understand or reverse engineer, with some Avgi scientists remarking that even the station's materials appear to intelligently circumvent attempts to probe their internal structure.`

units.english: Angko is a massive industrial world, with most cities on its surface supporting vast manufacturing sectors, factories, and warehouses. The level of industrial progress has not gone without its environmental impacts, however. At some time in the planet's past, the ice caps melted, causing sea levels to rise globally. The Bunrodeans have since moved to less environmentally negative practices, but the damage was already done, and the planet hasn't been the same since.
units.raw: description `Angko is a massive industrial world, with most cities on its surface supporting vast manufacturing sectors, factories, and warehouses. The level of industrial progress has not gone without its environmental impacts, however. At some time in the planet's past, the ice caps melted, causing sea levels to rise globally. The Bunrodeans have since moved to less environmentally negative practices, but the damage was already done, and the planet hasn't been the same since.`

units.english: The main spaceport of Angko is in a precarious situation: established ages ago on a coastline, the oceans of the planet have risen significantly enough that the entire region would be submerged in water were it not for the massive sea walls that enclose the city. Even with the flooding of the city being a constant concern should the sea walls fail, the Bunrodeans have determined that it's still easier to keep maintaining the main spaceport rather than move it to high ground.

Even with the flooding of the city being a constant concern should the sea walls fail, the Bunrodeans have determined that it's still easier to keep maintaining the main spaceport rather than move it to high ground.`

units.english: The surface of Anitlos, the largest moon of Oura, is a smooth landscape of ice pierced by rocky, metallic protrusions. These surface metal deposits, brought by a late asteroid bombardment a few hundred million years ago, served as one of the best sources of material for the cylinder habitats that clustered around Oura, its moons, and its Lagrange points.
units.raw: description `The surface of Anitlos, the largest moon of Oura, is a smooth landscape of ice pierced by rocky, metallic protrusions. These surface metal deposits, brought by a late asteroid bombardment a few hundred million years ago, served as one of the best sources of material for the cylinder habitats that clustered around Oura, its moons, and its Lagrange points.`

units.english: The other moons of Oura, while not quite as rich as Anitlos, are nonetheless a bounty of rare materials. Notably, rare elements like boron and beryllium, only produced by cosmic ray spallation of elements like oxygen, are produced at elevated rates in the ice of certain moons due to the trapping of charged particles by Oura's magnetic field.

Notably, rare elements like boron and beryllium, only produced by cosmic ray spallation of elements like oxygen, are produced at elevated rates in the ice of certain moons due to the trapping of charged particles by Oura's magnetic field.`

units.english: The planet's tempest winds thrum beneath vibrant emerald and velvet auroras that flare like curtains aflame. Derelict stations sprawl across its skies, a single flank of each bristling with empty missile tubes. A handful remain semi-intact, casting warm, rosy halos against the swirling clouds, launchers still baring skyward at forgotten foes.
units.raw: description `The planet's tempest winds thrum beneath vibrant emerald and velvet auroras that flare like curtains aflame. Derelict stations sprawl across its skies, a single flank of each bristling with empty missile tubes. A handful remain semi-intact, casting warm, rosy halos against the swirling clouds, launchers still baring skyward at forgotten foes.`

units.english: Antipode is a world of creeping glaciers and year-round snow, orbiting far enough from a dim star that even when the sun breaks through the clouds, it brings little warmth. The few settlements that exist here are built near surface deposits of rare earth metals that were discovered recently, and that are mined for use in electronics and equipment throughout this sector.
units.raw: description `Antipode is a world of creeping glaciers and year-round snow, orbiting far enough from a dim star that even when the sun breaks through the clouds, it brings little warmth. The few settlements that exist here are built near surface deposits of rare earth metals that were discovered recently, and that are mined for use in electronics and equipment throughout this sector.`

units.english: The inhabitants of Antipode are among the best downhill skiers in the galaxy, and they have made some attempts to draw off-world tourists to the ski resorts here, but the weather is so hostile that they have had very little success.
units.raw: description `	The inhabitants of Antipode are among the best downhill skiers in the galaxy, and they have made some attempts to draw off-world tourists to the ski resorts here, but the weather is so hostile that they have had very little success.`

units.english: Antipode is a frozen, unforgiving world, orbiting far enough from a dim star that even when the sun breaks through the clouds, it brings little warmth. The few settlements that exist here are built near surface deposits of rare earth metals that were discovered recently, and that are mined for use in electronics and equipment throughout this sector.
units.raw: description `Antipode is a frozen, unforgiving world, orbiting far enough from a dim star that even when the sun breaks through the clouds, it brings little warmth. The few settlements that exist here are built near surface deposits of rare earth metals that were discovered recently, and that are mined for use in electronics and equipment throughout this sector.`

units.english: What little amenities are available for the people living here are of subpar quality; a third of the houses lack a dedicated heating system, and it can take months before a store is able to restock its goods.
units.raw: description `	What little amenities are available for the people living here are of subpar quality; a third of the houses lack a dedicated heating system, and it can take months before a store is able to restock its goods.`

units.english: The inhabitants of Antipode are among the best downhill skiers in the galaxy, and they have made some attempts to draw off-world tourists to the ski resorts here, but the weather is so hostile, and living conditions so squalid, that they have had very little success.
units.raw: description `	The inhabitants of Antipode are among the best downhill skiers in the galaxy, and they have made some attempts to draw off-world tourists to the ski resorts here, but the weather is so hostile, and living conditions so squalid, that they have had very little success.`

units.english: The spaceport consists of a single enormous warehouse. The air inside is cold, but you are glad to get out of the howling wind. In one corner is a counter advertising skiing adventures, but no one is staffing it; they must be out to lunch or taking the day off.
units.raw: spaceport `The spaceport consists of a single enormous warehouse. The air inside is cold, but you are glad to get out of the howling wind. In one corner is a counter advertising skiing adventures, but no one is staffing it; they must be out to lunch or taking the day off.`

units.english: As with many of these small spaceports, it seems that the only option for food is a pub, but the smells coming from it are enticing; for once, you may have found a spaceport bar whose chef actually knows how to cook.
units.raw: spaceport `	As with many of these small spaceports, it seems that the only option for food is a pub, but the smells coming from it are enticing; for once, you may have found a spaceport bar whose chef actually knows how to cook.`

units.english: Once one of many, this was an enormous synchrotron particle accelerator several kilometers in diameter, dedicated towards the industrial production of large quantities of antimatter. With beamed power provided by the thousands of solar collection satellites around Anax, enough antimatter could be produced each year to supply both Avgi research and industrial efforts. The discovery of the hyperdrive nearly wiped the antimatter economy out overnight, with interstellar travel now almost trivial.
units.raw: description `Once one of many, this was an enormous synchrotron particle accelerator several kilometers in diameter, dedicated towards the industrial production of large quantities of antimatter. With beamed power provided by the thousands of solar collection satellites around Anax, enough antimatter could be produced each year to supply both Avgi research and industrial efforts. The discovery of the hyperdrive nearly wiped the antimatter economy out overnight, with interstellar travel now almost trivial.`

units.english: Combined, the amat farms around Anax once produced several tons of antimatter each year. The economic crash caused by the hyperdrive brought production to its knees, but the final death of Antivli Station appears to have come at the hands of the Aberrant.
units.raw: description `	Combined, the amat farms around Anax once produced several tons of antimatter each year. The economic crash caused by the hyperdrive brought production to its knees, but the final death of Antivli Station appears to have come at the hands of the Aberrant.`

units.english: The docks once used by specialized antimatter transport ships are wrecked beyond recognition, with only a small trickle of energy available. Beyond this, the beamlines once used to produce antimatter are broken and shattered - the antimatter plant is certainly beyond recovery.
units.raw: description `The docks once used by specialized antimatter transport ships are wrecked beyond recognition, with only a small trickle of energy available. Beyond this, the beamlines once used to produce antimatter are broken and shattered - the antimatter plant is certainly beyond recovery.`

units.english: The station's stockpile of antimatter, hundreds of tons held in reserve as antihydrogen ice plated with a thin layer of antilithium, appears to have likewise been lost to the Incursion. Whatever happened to the antimatter, it is at least certain that it did not breach its magnetic levitation containment tanks, as otherwise nothing of the station would be left but vapor.
units.raw: description `	The station's stockpile of antimatter, hundreds of tons held in reserve as antihydrogen ice plated with a thin layer of antilithium, appears to have likewise been lost to the Incursion. Whatever happened to the antimatter, it is at least certain that it did not breach its magnetic levitation containment tanks, as otherwise nothing of the station would be left but vapor.`

units.english: While this planet may have a rocky surface deep down, it is covered by kilometers-thick glaciers composed of water ice. Near the equator, a ring of craters push the ice up into circular ridges that cast long shadows across the landscape.
units.raw: description `While this planet may have a rocky surface deep down, it is covered by kilometers-thick glaciers composed of water ice. Near the equator, a ring of craters push the ice up into circular ridges that cast long shadows across the landscape.`

units.english: Covered in glaciers miles thick and bitterly cold, this planet is little more than a bleak ball of ice too far from its sun to be habitable. In the past, the Successors attempted to set up a shipyard here, but it eventually proved too costly to maintain and too poorly positioned to make up for it. Since it was abandoned, the Successors have made no further attempts to establish facilities here.
units.raw: description `Covered in glaciers miles thick and bitterly cold, this planet is little more than a bleak ball of ice too far from its sun to be habitable. In the past, the Successors attempted to set up a shipyard here, but it eventually proved too costly to maintain and too poorly positioned to make up for it. Since it was abandoned, the Successors have made no further attempts to establish facilities here.`

units.english: Arabia is an uncomfortably hot and humid world of deserts, savanna, and a few small and scattered rainforests. Large herds of bison-like animals roam the plains, providing the locals with a steady source of food. Occasional stampedes, involving tens of thousands of these animals, have been known to level entire towns here.
units.raw: description `Arabia is an uncomfortably hot and humid world of deserts, savanna, and a few small and scattered rainforests. Large herds of bison-like animals roam the plains, providing the locals with a steady source of food. Occasional stampedes, involving tens of thousands of these animals, have been known to level entire towns here.`

units.english: Aside from hunting, most of the industry takes the form of harvesting and refining petrochemicals to make plastics, polymers, and oils. In some parts of Arabia, the pumpjacks outnumber the people a hundred to one.
units.raw: description `	Aside from hunting, most of the industry takes the form of harvesting and refining petrochemicals to make plastics, polymers, and oils. In some parts of Arabia, the pumpjacks outnumber the people a hundred to one.`

units.english: The spaceport consists mostly of a wide, open field paved in asphalt, the cheapest material available here. The pavement shimmers with heat, and is pockmarked with divots where ships' landing gear has sunk several centimeters in to the surface.
units.raw: spaceport `The spaceport consists mostly of a wide, open field paved in asphalt, the cheapest material available here. The pavement shimmers with heat, and is pockmarked with divots where ships' landing gear has sunk several centimeters in to the surface.`

units.english: At the center of the pavement is a small cluster of refrigerated sheds and stacks of crates carrying various goods for trade; a few armed guards patrol around them to prevent theft. A food truck is parked nearby, serving burgers and tacos to the port workers and to the crews of the few starships that are parked here at the moment.
units.raw: spaceport `	At the center of the pavement is a small cluster of refrigerated sheds and stacks of crates carrying various goods for trade; a few armed guards patrol around them to prevent theft. A food truck is parked nearby, serving burgers and tacos to the port workers and to the crews of the few starships that are parked here at the moment.`

units.english: Despite the climate, a small procession of security guards and port workers is gathered in the spaceport to celebrate Remembrance Day.
units.raw: spaceport `	Despite the climate, a small procession of security guards and port workers is gathered in the spaceport to celebrate Remembrance Day.`

units.english: Arachne Station is privately owned by Tarazed Corporation, and there are no services available here for people who are not Tarazed employees.
units.raw: description `Arachne Station is privately owned by Tarazed Corporation, and there are no services available here for people who are not Tarazed employees.`

units.english: Araio is a relatively small world dominated by a single supercontinent. Continental uplift has made much of the land characterized by mountainous highland, scattered with numerous springs and lakes. Though the air is thin and the soil is rocky, hardy plants and woody trees cling to life, breaking up the landscape of rocky mountains with colorful meadows and bountiful forests.
units.raw: description `Araio is a relatively small world dominated by a single supercontinent. Continental uplift has made much of the land characterized by mountainous highland, scattered with numerous springs and lakes. Though the air is thin and the soil is rocky, hardy plants and woody trees cling to life, breaking up the landscape of rocky mountains with colorful meadows and bountiful forests.`

units.english: Araio garnered a reputation as a frontier world ripe for plucky pioneers, reminiscent of an oft-romanticized era on Aviskir. While rich in gemstones, natural stones have not been competitive with nanofabricated alternatives since long before the planet was settled, and thus the economy on the surface is almost completely dominated by homesteads and small frontier towns.
units.raw: description `	Araio garnered a reputation as a frontier world ripe for plucky pioneers, reminiscent of an oft-romanticized era on Aviskir. While rich in gemstones, natural stones have not been competitive with nanofabricated alternatives since long before the planet was settled, and thus the economy on the surface is almost completely dominated by homesteads and small frontier towns.`

units.english: Araio's spaceport was small but well run, capable of efficiently moving small volume goods on and off the world via a paired laser launch array and skyhook. The laser array was however razed from orbit by the Aberrant shortly after the fall of Anax, and the skyhook cut to pieces.
units.raw: spaceport `Araio's spaceport was small but well run, capable of efficiently moving small volume goods on and off the world via a paired laser launch array and skyhook. The laser array was however razed from orbit by the Aberrant shortly after the fall of Anax, and the skyhook cut to pieces.`

units.english: Though imports of advanced technology from other worlds, which the planet lacks the development to manufacture itself, were cut off with the Incursion, the planet is self-sufficient enough to get by for the foreseeable future - even if it means a slight regression in technology.
units.raw: spaceport `	Though imports of advanced technology from other worlds, which the planet lacks the development to manufacture itself, were cut off with the Incursion, the planet is self-sufficient enough to get by for the foreseeable future - even if it means a slight regression in technology.`

units.english: Now that the Korath are gone, the oceans on this planet have begun to teem with fish and other living creatures once again, and the levels of dissolved oxygen and carbon dioxide are slowly swinging back into balance. Species of algae and bacteria that are able to metabolize the plastics and chemicals that the Korath left behind have spread throughout the oceans.
units.raw: description `Now that the Korath are gone, the oceans on this planet have begun to teem with fish and other living creatures once again, and the levels of dissolved oxygen and carbon dioxide are slowly swinging back into balance. Species of algae and bacteria that are able to metabolize the plastics and chemicals that the Korath left behind have spread throughout the oceans.`

units.english: Arroharg is a low-gravity moon that the Quarg have converted to some sort of harvesting grounds. Massive machines that dwarf your ship seem to be displacing mountainous formations while smaller ones collect from the zones left behind. Most of the architecture here is Quarg-like and is not designed in a way that welcomes visitors very comfortably. The lower levels of the outpost seem to dig deeper into the surface of the moon, but the farther they go down, the more complex they become. There's no telling how deep into the moon they go, as they are restricted to everyone but the Quarg.

units.english: A few Quarg greet you with astonished expressions, but kindly assist you in anything you have trouble with due to the spaceport being designed for them. They communicate mostly in gestures and facial expressions, although they are sometimes hard to decipher. It seems they aren't used to outside visitors here and don't speak your language.
